answer: Mechanism: Rolling Attention Windows. Each identity gets randomized live micro-tasks from harbor sensors—e.g., confirm a vessel’s voyage label at the wharf or inlet crossing—under 2–5s latency with context-dependent answers. Rewards accrue only across sustained, non-repeating windows; idle, duplicated, or batch responses void the window. A sybil must run concurrent real-time attention/compute per identity, so attacker cost scales with attention-hours and latency, not signup.
